blocks.html: This documentation provides a reference to the `confirmInventoryStep`. It belongs to the `@medusajs/medusa/core-flows` package.

This step validates that items in the cart have sufficient inventory quantity.
If an item doesn't have sufficient inventory, an error is thrown.

children.name: items
children.description: The items to confirm inventory for.

children.name: inventory_item_id
children.description: The ID of the inventory item associated with the line item's variant.

children.name: required_quantity
children.description:
The number of units a single quantity is equivalent to. For example, if a customer orders one quantity of the variant, Medusa checks the availability of the quantity multiplied by the
value set for `required_quantity`. When the customer orders the quantity, Medusa reserves the ordered quantity multiplied by the value set for `required_quantity`.

children.name: allow_backorder
children.description: Whether the variant can be ordered even if it's out of stock. If a variant has this enabled, the step doesn't throw an error.

children.name: location_ids
children.description: The ID of the stock locations that the inventory quantity is available in.
